title: Two unit tests pin the hand-written test DB helper at user_version 4 and check its columns, not the production schema (version 7), so they assert the RC-28 drift as correct

evidence.note: "Schema v4: user_version pragma returns 4" on createTestDb()
schema validation cases list the helper's trades / exit_state columns

sibling_sites_checked: git grep "user_version" over test/unit: db.test.ts:76-81, helpers.smoke.test.ts:32-34 (helper, v4), db/*Migration.test.ts (their own replicas, AUD-TESTU-019). test/helpers/testDb.ts itself is TESTI scope (22-24, RC-28).
severity_rationale: S3: misleading assurance about the schema; the capital-relevant consequence (risk SQL on the wrong shape) is AUD-TESTU-017.
recommendation: Phase 28: build the test DB from the production migration (dbSchema.ts after the 22-09 move) and assert user_version equals CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION.
affected_cases: helpers.smoke.test.ts: createTestDb returns a working in-memory DB
escaped_regression: Add a v8 column that a production query depends on: the helper stays at v4, both version assertions stay green, and every helper-based test keeps running against a schema production no longer has.
